_doc: [onboard] The first-minutes story objectives (story/objectives.gd, ui/objective_card.gd). One at a time, in order, each with a one-line why (desc). brief.lines: WREN's one last message in the crash (two subtitle lines), then she is silent until the Signal Tower (story/signal_tower.gd). Objective fields: text (title), desc (the why), hint (shown instead of desc until wait_flag is set), type stat|robot|zone|hub_level|flag|core|tower|upgrade|bench ([v1guide] the workbench tier, ui/bench_tiers.gd), key, target (absolute: lifetime stats), desc/hint may hold {action} key glyphs, e.g. {cube} ([v1guide]); hex (true: outline the target hex on the ground with its % cleaned), lines (WREN, when the objective starts). Data stays English; tr() at display.

wren_brief._doc: [v2guide] WREN once the signal tower carries her (story/objectives.gd _narrate): who she is and the plan home. Then each new story step speaks its lines[0], once.
lines: Lumi, it's WREN. I run the Cradle, our big ship. I never stopped listening for you.
The Cradle can't land on a dead world. Let's make Verdance green again.
Plants make green light. It fills your Bloom Core, and it's the sign the Cradle looks for.
Lumi, it's WREN, up on the Cradle. Your pod fell by an old cleanup station, and my signal is weak.
Its bin turns trash into cubes. Build a signal tower with them so we can talk. I'll be [glitch]listen—[/glitch]

objectives.desc: The bin turns trash into cubes. The bench builds with cubes.
lines: Start small, Lumi. Every load in the bin earns cubes.

objectives.desc: Workbench: Chest Size. Fewer trips to the bin.
lines: A bigger chest means fewer trips. The bench can fit one.

objectives.desc: Workbench: grab more trash at once.
lines: A wider scoop. More trash per grab, less walking.

objectives.desc: The Baler presses trash into tight bales. Nothing is wasted, so a bale makes more cubes.
lines: Save up for the Baler. A tight bale wastes nothing, so it makes far more cubes.

objectives.desc: Press {cube} for a bale and carry it to the scale. Cubes for the signal tower.
lines: Carry bales to the scale by the bin. Three of them make plenty of cubes.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Build tab. Then WREN can talk to you.
lines: Build the tower, Lumi. Then I can stay with you.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Build tab. He lights the dark and finds trash you missed.
lines: Lumi... something's still holding on to your pod. Small. Lantern-shaped. Patch him up at the bench.

objectives.desc: Plants only grow on clean ground. Pick up every piece in the outline.
lines: First, one clean hex. Clear the outlined one. Green starts on clean ground.

objectives.desc: Clean ground lets plants grow again.
lines: Two clean hexes. Keep going, Lumi.

objectives.desc: Clear some room around the base. Then robots can start work.
lines: Three clean hexes. The planet notices, believe me.

objectives.text: Add a Bot Bay to the bench
objectives.desc: Workbench, Upgrades tab. A planet is too big for one small robot.
lines: Add a Bot Bay to the bench. You shouldn't do this alone.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Bots tab. Robots clean for you.
lines: The Bot Bay hums! It can build you a helper. Try the Bots tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: Robots clean where you point. Press {open_command} and paint hexes.
lines: Give your robot a hex to work on. It wants a job.

objectives.desc: Plants fill your Bloom Core.
objectives.hint: Keep cleaning. Seeds turn up in clean ground.
lines: Something green is waking out there. Plant the first seed.

objectives.desc: More clean ground, more room to plant. Robots help: press {open_command}.
lines: Ten clean hexes. Your robots are learning from you, Lumi.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Upgrades tab. A bigger base powers more robots.
lines: A bigger base makes more power, and power runs robots. Rebuild it at the workbench.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Bots tab. It carries bales to the scale for you.
objectives.hint: Keep cleaning. WREN is looking for Haul Bug plans.
lines: A Haul Bug carries bales for you. Build one at the bench.

objectives.desc: Workbench. A stronger signal lets WREN look further for you.
lines: Boost the tower. With a stronger signal I can look further for you.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Research tab. Research unlocks new robots.
lines: Your bench can study now. Research unlocks new machines and seeds.

objectives.desc: More clean ground means more room to grow.
lines: Twenty hexes. The air already smells different.

objectives.desc: Workbench, Upgrades tab. A stronger base runs bigger machines.
lines: One more base level, Lumi. Bigger machines need a stronger base.
